results.title: HubSpot’s Sales Hub pricing guide — essential features for every rep
results.content:
Sales Hub Professional costs $90 per seat/month if billed annually and $100 per seat/month for monthly billing. There is also a one-time onboarding fee of $1,500.

### How much does HubSpot really cost, including hidden fees?

The HubSpot per-seat price is straightforward; however, extra costs apply depending on the number of users, onboarding, and any additional Hubs or extra capacity you use. [...] | Sales Hub Professional | $90/seat (annual) or $100/seat (monthly) | Per user | 10 deal tags per account with rules for specific pipelines | Up to 300 fully customizable workflows | $1,500 |
| Sales Hub Enterprise | $150/seat | Per user | 10 deal tags per account with rules for specific pipelines | Up to 1,000 fully customizable workflows | $3,500 | [...] Choosing annual billing saves high costs:

 Starter: Save 40% with annual billing ($9 vs $15 per seat)
 Professional: Save 10% with annual billing ($90 vs $100 per seat)
 Enterprise: No discount (always $150 per seat)

Most teams find annual billing worthwhile, especially when factoring in the one-time onboarding fees for Professional ($1,500) and Enterprise ($3,500) plans.

results.title: 2026 HubSpot Pricing Guide | Cargas
results.content: Pricing for Sales Hub starts at $20 per month for the Starter tier, which includes one core seat, with additional core seats available for $20 each. The Professional tier starts at $100 per month and includes one sales seat, with extra sales seats costing $100 each and core seats available for $50. The Enterprise tier starts at $150 per month and includes one sales seat, with additional sales seats priced at $150 each and core seats at $75.

results.title: How Much Does HubSpot Cost? Pricing, Tiers, Discounts
results.content:
HubSpot Sales Hub Professional costs $90/user/month with 5 core seats included. Sales Hub Enterprise costs $150/user/month, also with 5 core seats included. These prices are negotiable, with most customers achieving 30-35% discounts.

### Can I use multiple HubSpot Hubs together? [...] HubSpot cost per user depends on the Hub and tier. Sales Hub Professional costs $90/user/month, while Sales Hub Enterprise costs $150/user/month. Other Hubs use a different model with core seats included in the base price, then additional seats cost $45/month (Professional) or $75/month (Enterprise).

### Does HubSpot offer annual payment discounts? [...] Professional: $800/month (includes 3 core seats + 2,000 contacts), additional seats $45/month
 Enterprise: $3,600/month (includes 5 core seats + 10,000 contacts), additional seats $75/month
